LanguageData.HSH.Settings.Enabled.Desc: Turn the whole mod off without unloading it. Switching this off also clears any thoughts it has already handed out.
LanguageData.HSH.Settings.Separation.Desc: Colonists carry a thought for each person they're separated from, growing the longer that person stays gone.
LanguageData.HSH.Settings.Reunion.Desc: Everyone at the colony reacts to a returning traveller, based on what they think of them and how long the trip took.
LanguageData.HSH.Settings.Gloating: Enjoy the absence of people they dislike
LanguageData.HSH.Settings.Gloating.Desc: Rivals and enemies leaving is a mood boost, and their return is not. Turn this off to keep only the positive relationships.
LanguageData.HSH.Settings.Homesickness.Desc: Travellers wear down the longer they're away from the colony.
LanguageData.HSH.Settings.Homecoming.Desc: The relief of getting back through the gate, scaled by the length of the trip.
LanguageData.HSH.Settings.Destination.Desc: A smaller boost for reaching whatever the caravan set out for.
LanguageData.HSH.Settings.Companions.Desc: Travelling alongside friends and family lifts the mood. Travelling alongside someone they hate does the opposite.
LanguageData.HSH.Settings.TravelBonds.Desc: Finishing a trip together shifts how the travellers see each other afterwards.
LanguageData.HSH.Settings.CampCountsAsAway: Camping still counts as being away
LanguageData.HSH.Settings.CampCountsAsAway.Desc: Setting up camp is never treated as coming home. Turn this off if you'd rather a camped caravan stopped worrying the people back at the colony.
LanguageData.HSH.Settings.CampThoughts.Desc: A minor mood boost while a caravan is settled in a camp rather than out walking.
LanguageData.HSH.Settings.CampWear: Days in camp count as {0} of a day on the road
LanguageData.HSH.Settings.CampWear.Desc: How much a day spent camped wears a traveller down compared to a day of travel. Lower means camps are more restful. This only affects homesickness, not how long the colony thinks they've been gone.
LanguageData.HSH.Settings.Intensity.Desc: Scales every mood and opinion effect this mod produces.
LanguageData.HSH.Settings.MinAbsence.Desc: Nothing fires until a colonist has been gone this long, so short errands stay quiet.
LanguageData.HSH.Settings.ClearThoughts: Clear all Home Sweet Home thoughts now
